title: PRESS RELEASE – Uganda Communications Commission Announces Successful Applicants for the 2025 Research Support to Academia Call
text:
PRESS
RELEASE
Uganda Communications Commission Announces Successful
Applicants for the 2025 Research Support to Academia Call
The Uganda Communications Commission (UCC) is pleased to announce the successful
applicants under the 2025 Call for Proposals for Research Support to Academia
implemented under the UCC Research Support and Collaboration Framework.
The programme is implemented in accordance with Section 5(1)(l) of the Uganda
Communications Act, 2013, which mandates UCC to promote research into the
development and use of new communications techniques and technologies, including
those that enhance access to communications services. Through this initiative, UCC
supports academic research that advances innovation, evidence-based policy
development, and the growth of Uganda’s communications and ICT sector.
Following a competitive evaluation process comprising eligibility screening and technical
assessment, nine(9) proposals successfully passed the evaluation process and were
recommended for support.
The selected projects reflect UCC’s commitment to promoting research, innovation, digital
transformation, accessibility, cybersecurity, and evidence-based policy development in
Uganda’s communications sector

UCC congratulates the successful applicants and their respective institutions.
The selected applicants will proceed to the grant agreement and project implementation
phase in accordance with the applicable terms and conditions under the Research
Support and Collaboration Framework.
Through this initiative, UCC continues to strengthen collaboration with academia and
support research that contributes to Uganda’s digital economy, inclusive access to
communications services, innovation, and evidence-based regulation.
